name: Auriferous-Quoin
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a tidally locked hemisphere, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.

The terrain around the escape pod debris field is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
